description: This file defines a Fragment class for an Android app that displays a grid of images, manages image caching and asynchronous loading, handles user interactions including item clicks, and dynamically adjusts layout based on view size. It also includes an internal adapter class for managing grid items.

classes.name: ImageGridFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that displays a grid of image thumbnails, manages loading and caching images, and responds to user interactions to show image details.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, sets up image cache parameters and the image fetcher.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout, sets up the GridView, its adapter, and listeners for layout changes and scrolling.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Resumes image fetching and updates the grid view.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Pauses image fetching and clears cache.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Closes image cache to free resources.

methods.name: onItemClick
methods.description: Handles item click events to launch a detailed view of the selected image.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, such as clearing cache.
